broken.what: The step meant to show the Electricity topic page after the record shows the My record page again, on both phone and laptop. Either '← Electricity' did not navigate or the topic page was never reached. So we cannot see whether the Quick check now shows as done or whether the post-tests unlocked.

The record's score split does not match the test result. The record shows exam-style 4/5 and 'What really happens' 3/8, which is 7/13. The result check gave 11/17. Four marks are missing or uncounted with no explanation. Also, Q12 and Q13 (2 parts) were wrong, so 4/5 exam-style marks looks too high.

looks_wrong.what: The 'Back to Electricity' and 'My record' buttons are cut off at the bottom edge of the viewport. They are only half visible until you scroll.
The action buttons are not visible at all on the first screen. She must scroll past a long list to find any way forward.

The Tests table is squeezed into four narrow columns. 'Quick check before you start' wraps over 3 lines and the 'Exam-style marks' and '"What really happens"' headings break mid-phrase, so it is hard to scan.
The header buttons are unlabelled icons on phone. Nothing says which one is home, settings or topics.

fixes.change: Route it to the Electricity topic list (not re-render My record) and capture that page so the Quick check status can be confirmed as done.

fixes.target: My record Tests table, marks columns
fixes.change: Show the total as on the result (e.g. 11/17), then the exam-style and 'what really happens' parts, with parts that add up to the total. Recheck the exam-style tally against Q12/Q13.
Put 'Back to Electricity' and 'My record' buttons above the lists as well as below, or make them sticky at the bottom on phone.

Add visible short labels or aria-label plus tooltip (Home, Topics, Settings) on phone.
